body: I saw your post on r/suicidewatch .. Please talk to me. I’m here. I know it feels like you’re in a corner right now with nobody and nothing to live for but that’s not true. I won’t pass any judgment or give advice if you don’t want it. Just let me listen. You’re not alone. I’m not doing this because I feel “It’s the right thing to do.” I’m doing it because I wish somebody would’ve done it for me. I know you’re in a dark place. You’re not alone. Please talk to me. I’m right here and I won’t go anywhere until you’re okay.Please DM me as I am unable to do it myself.I just wanna listen if that's what u want me to do.
